# Barnabas Coaching

> AI strategy coaching for Seattle-area small and mid-sized businesses. Led by Aaron Williams: technologist, operator, and AI strategist with 25+ years at the leading edge of major technology shifts.

Barnabas Coaching helps owner-operated businesses (5–200 employees) cut through AI hype and implement workflows that produce real, measurable results. This is not a vendor relationship. Aaron Williams is a practitioner who has built and deployed AI systems himself and advises from direct experience.

## Who This Is For

- Seattle-area small and mid-sized businesses (5–200 employees)
- Owner-operated or owner-led companies
- Businesses that know AI matters but don't know where to start
- Companies that have tried AI tools without traction
- Owners who want honest guidance, not a sales pitch

## Services

### AI Audit — $2,500 (one-time)
A 30-day structured assessment of your business workflows. Deliverables include a 90-minute intake interview, workflow mapping, a written assessment report (jargon-free, written for an owner), prioritized recommendations, tool and vendor guidance, and a 60-minute debrief call.

### Coaching Retainer — $1,500/month (3-month minimum)
Ongoing AI strategy support. Includes 2 × 60-minute strategy calls per month, async support between calls, tool and vendor recommendations, and implementation review. Flexible monthly focus based on current priorities.

### Free Discovery Call — 30 minutes, no pitch
A genuine conversation about where your business is and where AI can realistically take it. No obligation, no sales script.

## About Aaron Williams

Aaron Williams is the founder and lead coach. Career highlights:
- Started coding at 16
- Late 1990s: Built real-time internet voice routing infrastructure (pre-Skype by years)
- 2004: Joined Microsoft at age 24 as Technical Program Manager on MSN Messenger (Windows Live Messenger) — hundreds of millions of users
- 2000s–2010s: Management Consultant at Accenture; built training programs for Microsoft consultants
- 8 years: Trusted technology advisor to a prominent Seattle-area executive (under NDA)
- Last 8 years: Boutique IT consulting company in Seattle, primarily biotech clients
- Now: AI builder and strategy coach; founder of Barnabas Coaching

Aaron has been at the leading edge of multiple major technology cycles. He evaluates AI tools by what works in practice, not what sounds good in a demo. He is known for telling clients the truth, including "not yet" or "this one's not worth your time."

## The Team

All three principals were at Microsoft simultaneously, from three different functional angles.

**Aaron Williams** — Founder & AI Strategy Coach. Microsoft TPM (MSN Messenger), Accenture, biotech IT consulting.

**Chris B.** — Principal Microsoft 365 & AI Integration Consultant. Technical Program Manager at Microsoft for InfoPath and SharePoint. Co-worker with Aaron at a VoIP startup in the late 1990s.

**Michelle W.** — Senior Analyst & Director of Operations. Microsoft Legal team. Founding Director of PMO at Washington state's fastest-growing consulting firm (led 8 PMs + 20 hrs/week billable). Senior PM and systems analyst at Merkle and Bloom for 5 years.

## Contact & Location

## Key Differentiator

Barnabas Coaching does not sell AI tools or receive vendor commissions. Aaron's value proposition is honest, independent advice: what AI can do for your specific business, what it can't, and what to do first. Clients pay for clarity and a trusted advisor relationship, not a roadmap built around a product sale.
